{
  "name": "approval-md",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Human approval for agent actions. CLI runtime for the approval.md convention (pre-release).",
  "type": "module",
  "bin": {
    "approval": "./cli.js"
  },
  "exports": {
    "./adapters": {
      "types": "./dist/src/adapters/public.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/src/adapters/public.js"
    }
  },
  "files": [
    "cli.js",
    "dist/src",
    "schema",
    "docs/adapter-api.md",
    "docs/cli-reference.md",
    "SPEC.md",
    "README.md",
    "LICENSE",
    "NOTICE",
    "docs/codex-enforced-session.md",
    "templates/codex"
  ],
  "repository": "github:approval-md/approval.md",
  "homepage": "https://approval.md",
  "author": "Carter Crouch",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json",
    "codex:mcp": "node .codex/approval-mcp.mjs",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs",
    "lint": "oxlint src tests",
    "ci:local": "node scripts/ci-local.mjs",
    "check:tier": "node scripts/classify-tier.mjs",
    "check:changed": "node scripts/classify-tier.mjs --working-tree --run",
    "conformance": "tsc -p tsconfig.json && node conformance/run.mjs"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/better-sqlite3": "9.6.0",
    "@types/node": "^26.1.2",
    "oxlint": "^1.77.0",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "1.30.0",
    "ajv": "8.20.0",
    "ajv-formats": "3.0.1",
    "better-sqlite3": "12.11.1",
    "yaml": "2.9.0"
  }
}
